description: Global color tokens for the Loveplug landing page design, matched to the real logo (rose/hot-pink gradient on near-black).

bg.usage: Page background (near-black with a wine undertone)

surface.usage: Card/section surfaces sitting above bg (e.g. product cards, story section)

surface-2.usage: Secondary/elevated surface, used in gradients and product media panels

ink.usage: Primary text on dark backgrounds (headings, nav)

accent.usage: Primary brand pink — buttons, links, icons, price tags, marquee background

accent-soft.usage: Light blush pink — headline emphasis (italic words), eyebrow labels, hover states

accent-deep.usage: Deep rose — borders/shadows on accent elements, badge outlines

cream.usage: Warm neutral reserved for light-surface accents (unused in current dark build)

cream-ink.usage: Text color if paired with the cream surface

accentTints.description: Common rgba(accent) opacity variants used throughout the CSS for glows, gradients and hover fills

accentSoftTints.description: Common rgba(accent-soft) opacity variants used for rings, text-strokes and soft glows

display.usage: Headlines, wordmark, product names, pull quotes

sans.usage: Body copy, nav, buttons, labels (stand-in for the live site's Geist)

whatsappGreen.usage: WhatsApp floating action button — kept as WhatsApp's own brand color, not part of the Loveplug palette
